venue.name: Multiple venues. [Please see the Locations tab](#33462-locations)

items.information: FMC New Zealand 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is the National Championship for the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event. FMC New Zealand 2023 is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please note this competition is for the [3x3x3 Fewest Moves event](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) which is different to the main 3x3x3 cube event. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JPIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09f328966024b349b182c10e5943a3983f83b9cd/snz_logo_v06.png) [Website](https://speedcubing.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnz)

items.information: Bem-vindo à primeira competição de cubo mágico de Rondonópolis. **REGISTRO** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o número em questão (whatsapp). 2. Será cobrada uma taxa de R$10 por acompanhante que também deverá ser paga pela chave PIX informada. 3. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do whatsapp ou email informado. 4. Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. --- Welcome to the first Rondonópolis Rubik's Cube Competition. **REGISTRATION** Participation in this competition requires the competitor to have knowledge of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration fee will be R$ 30, and payment should be made via PIX to the account 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). The payment receipt should be sent to the same number (WhatsApp). 2. A fee of R$ 10 per guest will be charged, and this fee should also be paid through the provided PIX account. 3. For additional information, please check the WCA website or contact the organizer via WhatsApp or the provided email address. 4. Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Scarborough Fall 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Scarborough Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ScarboroughFallA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
